title: Top and bottom bezels inappropriately scale vertically, consuming to much space for tall notes
line: Tall and wide Sticky Notes no longer get big empty margins above and below (or beside) the text.
explanation: The note's text margins were 7% of the widget's width on the sides and 7% of its height on top and bottom, so the gap between the paper's edge and the text grew with the long side: a 736 px tall note started its text about 47 px from the top, against 28 px in a square one. The note is a single stretched SVG whose paper sits about 4.5% of the width and 2.5% of the height inside it. The margins now keep following the paper's edge along each side but add a gap to the text that depends only on the shorter side, so square notes look exactly as before and tall or wide notes keep small margins.

commits.message:
applets/notes: Keep text margins small on tall and wide notes

The text margins were 7% of the note's height on top and bottom and 7%
of its width on the sides, so tall notes got big empty bands. Keep the
paper's edge, but base the extra gap to the text on the shorter side.

BUG: 403458

patches.diff:
From be69fb4f741cc48bf69a8babc0e7acdf3e34885d Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:59:47 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/notes: Keep text margins small on tall and wide notes

The text margins were 7% of the note's height on top and bottom and 7%
of its width on the sides, so tall notes got big empty bands. Keep the
paper's edge, but base the extra gap to the text on the shorter side.

BUG: 403458
---
 applets/notes/qml/main.qml | 9 ++++++---
 1 file changed, 6 insertions(+), 3 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/notes/qml/main.qml b/applets/notes/qml/main.qml
index 63a6409ba..c19465f26 100644
--- a/applets/notes/qml/main.qml
+++ b/applets/notes/qml/main.qml
@@ -34,9 +34,12 @@ PlasmoidItem {
     Plasmoid.icon: "knotes-symbolic"
     Plasmoid.backgroundHints: PlasmaCore.Types.NoBackground
 
-    // this isn't a frameSVG, the default SVG margins take up around 7% of the frame size, so we use that
-    readonly property int horizontalMargins: Math.round(fullRepresentationItem.width * 0.07)
-    readonly property int verticalMargins: Math.round(fullRepresentationItem.height * 0.07)
+    // This isn't a FrameSvg: the note is one SVG element stretched to the widget, and its paper sits about 4.5% of the
+    // width and 2.5% of the height inside it. The text gets a gap to the paper's edge that only grows with the shorter
+    // side, so a tall or wide note doesn't get huge margins along its long side.
+    readonly property real shorterSide: Math.min(fullRepresentationItem.width, fullRepresentationItem.height)
+    readonly property int horizontalMargins: Math.round(fullRepresentationItem.width * 0.045 + shorterSide * 0.025)
+    readonly property int verticalMargins: Math.round(fullRepresentationItem.height * 0.025 + shorterSide * 0.045)
     readonly property PlasmaComponents3.TextArea mainTextArea: (fullRepresentationItem as FullRepresentation)?.mainTextArea
     readonly property bool inPanel: [PlasmaCore.Types.TopEdge, PlasmaCore.Types.RightEdge,PlasmaCore.Types.BottomEdge, PlasmaCore.Types.LeftEdge].includes(Plasmoid.location)
     readonly property bool compactInPanel: inPanel && !!compactRepresentationItem?.visible
--

media.caption: Master, 304x304 and 304x736 notes with three lines each: the tall note's text starts about 47 px below its top, the square note's about 28 px
With the fix, same notes: the tall note's text starts about 27 px below its top, like the square note, and its toolbar sits closer to the bottom

review.text: Cleanly fixes the excessive margins on tall and wide Sticky Notes in applets/notes/qml/main.qml by separating the stretched SVG's outer paper offset (4.5% width / 2.5% height) from the inner text gap and scaling that inner gap by Math.min(width, height). Square notes remain visually identical to master while tall and wide notes keep compact, consistent margins, as verified by the before/after screenshots.

reviews.text: Cleanly fixes the excessive margins on tall and wide Sticky Notes in applets/notes/qml/main.qml by separating the stretched SVG's outer paper offset (4.5% width / 2.5% height) from the inner text gap and scaling that inner gap by Math.min(width, height). Square notes remain visually identical to master while tall and wide notes keep compact, consistent margins, as verified by the before/after screenshots.

The text margins were 7% of each dimension, so tall or wide notes got large empty bands; the new formula reduces to exactly 7% on square notes and only grows the paper-edge part along the long side, which matches what the retitled bug asks for. The before/after shots show the tall note's top gap dropping to the square note's value with the square note unchanged, and the commit message matches the 6-line QML change. It stays a small change in the right file with no binding or layout hazards (the margins feed only the FocusScope anchors).
